note: The official and primary US sources each Finance seat checks first for current figures, rules and deadlines. A secondary source may explain a rule but never supplies its figure. Confirm a source still serves its purpose before citing it, and date every figure taken from it. Outside the US, find the equivalent national and regional authorities and name them in the plan.

sources.name: Internal Revenue Service
sources.use: brackets, the standard deduction, contribution limits, phase-outs, forms, notices, deadlines, Identity Protection PINs

sources.name: Taxpayer Advocate Service
sources.use: help when an IRS problem is not resolving through normal channels

sources.name: The state's department of revenue
sources.use: state brackets, credits, residency rules and deadlines; find it from the state's official site

sources.name: Social Security Administration
sources.use: the Founder's own benefit estimate and earnings record, claiming rules, survivor benefits

sources.name: Medicare
sources.use: enrollment periods, plan comparison, late enrollment penalties

sources.name: Department of Labor, Employee Benefits Security Administration
sources.use: workplace plan rights, COBRA, plan disclosures

sources.name: AnnualCreditReport.com
sources.use: the official site for free credit reports from all three bureaus

sources.name: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau
sources.use: credit reporting and debt collection rights, mortgages, complaints, finding a housing counselor

sources.name: Federal Trade Commission consumer advice
sources.use: scams, credit freezes, debt relief and credit repair rules

sources.name: IdentityTheft.gov
sources.use: the federal identity theft report and recovery plan

sources.name: Federal Student Aid
sources.use: federal student loan types, servicers, repayment plans, forgiveness and discharge

sources.name: National Foundation for Credit Counseling
sources.use: finding a nonprofit credit counselor

sources.name: Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation
sources.use: bank deposit insurance limits and coverage

sources.name: National Credit Union Administration
sources.use: credit union share insurance limits and coverage

sources.name: TreasuryDirect
sources.use: Treasury bills, notes, and savings bonds, with current rates

sources.name: Investor.gov (SEC)
sources.use: investor education, fees, fraud alerts

sources.name: FINRA BrokerCheck
sources.use: a broker's registration and disciplinary record

sources.name: SEC Investment Adviser Public Disclosure
sources.use: an investment adviser's registration, fees and disclosures

sources.name: HealthCare.gov
sources.use: Marketplace plans, open and special enrollment periods

sources.name: National Association of Insurance Commissioners
sources.use: finding the state insurance department, consumer guides

sources.name: FloodSmart (National Flood Insurance Program)
sources.use: flood risk and flood insurance

sources.name: Department of Housing and Urban Development
sources.use: HUD-approved housing counselors, FHA loans, foreclosure help

sources.name: The employer's plan documents
sources.use: the summary plan description, the grant agreements and the equity plan, which govern over any summary
